text: **SA18-21** (53): used by SA18-1 (45:34-36 hyperalgebra; 53:22-34 distributions) and SA18-2 (45:2-17, 45:45-59).
**SA18-1** (45:18-42, 53:22-34): used by SA18-2 (45:9 Lie algebra of the kernel; 45:18-26 Borel normalisers), SA18-7 (46:17-22).
**SA18-2** (45:2-17, 45:45-59; cote 48 plan; cote 56 SGA 3 XII typescript): used by SA18-6 (46:72-91 twisting and Lang).
**SA18-8** (46:20-22; 54:5-7): uses SA18-7 and SA18-17; links SA14 (Picard), SA15 (crystals, Oda).
**SA18-10** (46:41-65): uses SA18-17 (representability of Pic, 46:47) and SA18-6.

**SA18-17** (49-52): uses EGA IV 2.8 closures (51:3-6), and 49 (Pic^0 abelian) is used by 47 (SA18-13) and 54 (SA18-14). 52 (Torelli) links SA19 (Jacobians). 51 links SA15-19 (good reduction, Néron models, p-divisible groups).
**SA18-13** (47): uses SA18-14 (54, duality) and SA18-17 (49, NS and Pic^0); links SA07 (motives, Deninger-Murre), SA19.
**SA18-14** (54): links SA15-16 (6:25-26, the universal extension and the Dieudonné crystal).
**SA18-16** (56): uses SA18-3; links SA06 (vanishing cycles, Picard-Lefschetz: SGA 7 XII, XV).
